dsh-ui-font is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Font engine for the Web GUI: system font enumeration, global and per-component font-size tuning with a Spy++-style picker, settings page.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-820c9fa91a958848eb50.html
